article.body_preview:
DHAKA - A college friend who was once an outstanding student failed to do well in his IT career. His family of two university students barely managed with his single income until the pandemic. But since then, the price of his basket of goods has increased significantly. As a result, the family is finding it very hard to make ends meet with his monthly income of Tk 60,000.

To make matters worse, he recently got fired by his struggling IT company, which is heavily dependent on the export market.
